source.quote_free_summary: Where possible a division's smaller heats precede its larger ones so that, after scratches, the Contest Coordinator can move contestants up to keep heats balanced.

requirement: A future UCWDC profile supports a separate, audited move-up (from heat, to heat, reason scratch, actor, link to the original randomization evidence) by the Contest Coordinator; it is a change of assignment, not part of the running-order reorder, and is not converted into a hard blocker.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. Separate slice (S6). Coordinated with OD-25 reproducible randomization (seed, algorithm version, final order).
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED and a profile blocker for the UCWDC move-up capability. Modal language is 'Whenever possible'. Printed page 1.
decision_refs: OD-26 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: controlled, audited mid-event running-order changes, design-level draft; retrospective audit PR #795)
